"""Causal word-duration controls with measured MMS spans and phone stability."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import traceback

import numpy as np
import pyworld
import soundfile as sf

from hindi_detector.artifacts import write_group
from hindi_detector.corrected_synthesis import sha
from hindi_detector.local_features import PROSODY_NAMES
from hindi_detector.rhythm_transfer import duration_map, retime_parameters
from hindi_detector.structured_detector import context
from hindi_detector.word_evidence import WordEvidenceEngine
from scripts.build_prosody_interventions import detail
from scripts.calibrate_asr_gate import audio
from scripts.extract_corrected_training import read_rows

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def phone_distance(a, b):
    a, b = a.split(), b.split()
    previous = list(range(len(b) + 1))
    for i, left in enumerate(a, 1):
        current = [i]
        for j, right in enumerate(b, 1):
            current.append(min(current[-1] + 1, previous[j] + 1, previous[j - 1] + (left != right)))
        previous = current
    return previous[-1]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--recovery-v52', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    plan = ROOT / 'data/prosody_transfer_v49'
    original = ROOT / 'reports/structured_evidence_v15'
    extra = ROOT / 'reports/prosody_native_donor_features_v49'
    out = ROOT / ('reports/rhythm_interventions_v52' if args.recovery_v52 else 'reports/rhythm_interventions_v51')
    minimum = .03 if args.recovery_v52 else .08
    if out.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(out)
    accepted = set(json.loads((ROOT / 'reports/prosody_native_donor_content_v49/result.json').read_text())['accepted_ids'])
    third = {row['id']: row for row in read_rows(extra / 'items.jsonl')}
    selection = json.loads((plan / 'transfer_plan.json').read_text())
    write_group(out, {'protocol.json': {'mode': 'relative_word_duration_only',
        'partitions': {'train': 100, 'development': 24, 'reserved_evaluation': 40},
        'inputs': 'Same frozen164-word/conditioning-group partitions as pitch experiment; no rhythm model fitted or reserved rhythm scores inspected before this protocol.',
        'prior_exposure': 'The word sets previously appeared in v49 pitch-only evaluation. They remain held out from rhythm fitting, not globally untouched data.',
        'intervention': 'Redistribute Native word durations proportional to donor word lengths; preserve Native absolute pauses, total utterance length and all Native spectral/F0/aperiodicity values under monotone time warp.',
        'admissibility': 'Local duration ratio.4..2.5, explicit minimum word' + str(round(minimum * 1000)) + 'ms; finite outputs; lexical Native donor ASR pass; identical aligned words.',
        'protocol_recovery': ('v51 failed before any model fitting:58train/13dev/21reserved below preset60/15/25 quotas. Metadata audit identified natural short function words such as म/यो/र below80ms. New30ms floor retains six WORLD frames, same stretch bounds; exact last-word-at-duration boundary fixed. No v51 checkpoint or reserved rhythm scores existed.' if args.recovery_v52 else None),
        'measurement': 'MMS_FA re-aligns emitted WAV; only measured duration_relative,pause_before_relative,pause_after_relative with+/-2 word context feed model, not intended warp landmarks.',
        'phone_audit': 'Free phone edit distance relative to original Native compared to sham baseline; exact-stability subset reported separately, never called human gold.',
        'labels': 'Physical Hindi-checkpoint versus Native-donor word rhythm, not unacceptable Hindi-error gold.',
        'model': '40->8->1 MLP with training-only normalization; minimum dev BCE of300 epochs; high=max(.5,max dev native+.00001), frozen before reserved scoring.',
        'nuisance': 'Reserved sham +/-3 semitones and gain.4, same duration intent. Extra flags over WORLD sham explicitly reported.',
        'source_plan_sha256': sha(plan / 'transfer_plan.json')},
        'source_snapshot.json': [{'path': str(p.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': sha(p), 'source_utf8': p.read_text()}
            for p in (Path(__file__), ROOT / 'hindi_detector/rhythm_transfer.py', ROOT / 'hindi_detector/word_evidence.py')]},
        'Word-rhythm causal controls. protocol.json frozen before synthesis/score fitting. '
        'audio/*.wav Native-spectrum monotone word-duration interventions and WORLD shams, '
        'features/*.npz measured40-dimensional contextual rhythm pair and29-column measured '
        'query/reference matrices. details/*.json actual MMS word boundaries, free phones and '
        'prosody per output. rows.jsonl pins source/output SHA/bytes, intended-vs-measured '
        'duration and phone-edit-over-sham audit, explicit exclusions. runtime.json exact frozen '
        'acoustic identities, status/report actual progress. No donor pitch/spectrum imported. '
        'No human accent labels or live model changes. Consumer rhythm model admission test; '
        'review2026-11-10, raw audio/frames expire24h after consumer closes, retain compact '
        'metrics/configs/selected state. No HF upload; inherited MMS/probe/source rights.',
        ['.venv-indicf5/bin/python -m scripts.build_rhythm_interventions'])
    for name in ('audio', 'features', 'details'):
        (out / name).mkdir()
    counts = Counter()
    engine = WordEvidenceEngine(ROOT, device='mps', pitch_method='dio')
    (out / 'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps({'alignment': engine.aligner_inventory, 'phone_probe': engine.phone_inventory,
        'vocabulary': engine.vocab, 'device': 'mps', 'pitch_method': 'dio'}, indent=2) + '\n')
    try:
        for item in selection:
            record = {k: item[k] for k in ('id', 'word', 'split', 'text', 'word_ordinal', 'conditioning_groups')}
            try:
                row = third[item['third_native_donor_job']]
                if row['id'] not in accepted or row['status'] != 'ok_rendered_phone_frames':
                    raise ValueError('Third Native donor failed content/feature qualification')
                cd, rd, hd = [detail(original, item[key]) for key in ('carrier', 'comparison_reference', 'hindi_prosody_donor')]
                nd = detail(extra, row)
                words = [word['word'] for word in cd['words']]
                if any([word['word'] for word in d['words']] != words for d in (rd, hd, nd)):
                    raise ValueError('Same-text word identities differ')
                ordinal = item['word_ordinal']
                carrier_row = item['carrier']['row']
                samples = audio(Path(carrier_row['source_pack']), carrier_row).astype(np.float64)
                f0, times = pyworld.dio(samples, 16000, f0_floor=50., f0_ceil=650., frame_period=5.)
                f0 = pyworld.stonemask(samples, f0, times, 16000)
                sp, ap = pyworld.cheaptrick(samples, f0, times, 16000), pyworld.d4c(samples, f0, times, 16000)
                reference = np.array([[w['prosody'][name] for name in PROSODY_NAMES] for w in rd['words']], np.float32)
                seconds = len(samples) / 16000
                conditions = [('sham', cd, 1., 1., 0), ('native_transfer', nd, 1., 1., 0), ('hindi_transfer', hd, 1., 1., 1)]
                if item['split'] == 'reserved_evaluation':
                    conditions += [('sham_pitch_plus3', cd, np.exp2(3 / 12), 1., 0),
                                   ('sham_pitch_minus3', cd, np.exp2(-3 / 12), 1., 0), ('sham_gain', cd, 1., .4, 0)]
                outputs = []
                for name, donor, pitch_factor, gain, label in conditions:
                    source_knots, target_knots, intended, ratios = duration_map(cd['words'], donor['words'], seconds, minimum_word_seconds=minimum)
                    pitch, spectral, noise = retime_parameters(times, f0, sp, ap, source_knots, target_knots)
                    wave = pyworld.synthesize(pitch * pitch_factor, spectral, noise, 16000, frame_period=5.)[:len(samples)] * gain
                    if len(wave) != len(samples) or not np.isfinite(wave).all() or np.max(np.abs(wave)) > 1.5:
                        raise ValueError('Invalid emitted duration-control waveform')
                    wp = out / 'audio' / (item['id'] + '_' + name + '.wav')
                    sf.write(wp, wave, 16000, subtype='FLOAT')
                    emitted, rate = sf.read(wp, dtype='float32')
                    if rate != 16000:
                        raise ValueError('Emitted control sample rate changed')
                    measured, _ = engine.analyze(emitted, item['text'])
                    if [word['word'] for word in measured['words']] != words:
                        raise ValueError('Emission re-alignment lost word identity')
                    q = np.array([[w['prosody'][column] for column in PROSODY_NAMES] for w in measured['words']], np.float32)
                    delta = context(q[:, :3])[ordinal] - context(reference[:, :3])[ordinal]
                    x = np.concatenate([delta, np.abs(delta)]).astype(np.float32)
                    if x.shape != (40,) or not np.isfinite(x).all():
                        raise ValueError('Measured contextual rhythm dimensions differ')
                    fp = out / 'features' / (item['id'] + '_' + name + '.npz')
                    np.savez_compressed(fp, paired_rhythm=x, query_prosody=q, reference_prosody=reference)
                    dp = out / 'details' / (item['id'] + '_' + name + '.json')
                    dp.write_text(json.dumps(measured, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
                    actual = measured['words'][ordinal]
                    outputs.append({'condition': name, 'source_style_label': label,
                        'audio': str(wp.relative_to(out)), 'audio_sha256': sha(wp), 'audio_bytes': wp.stat().st_size,
                        'features': str(fp.relative_to(out)), 'features_sha256': sha(fp), 'features_bytes': fp.stat().st_size,
                        'detail': str(dp.relative_to(out)), 'detail_sha256': sha(dp), 'detail_bytes': dp.stat().st_size,
                        'actual_word_duration_seconds': actual['end'] - actual['start'],
                        'intended_word_duration_seconds': float(intended[ordinal, 1] - intended[ordinal, 0]),
                        'focal_word_stretch': float(ratios[ordinal]), 'phone_sequence': actual['phone_probe_sequence'],
                        'phone_edit_distance_from_carrier': phone_distance(actual['phone_probe_sequence'], cd['words'][ordinal]['phone_probe_sequence']),
                        'actual_hindi_error_label': None})
                for output in outputs:
                    output['additional_phone_edits_over_sham'] = output['phone_edit_distance_from_carrier'] - outputs[0]['phone_edit_distance_from_carrier']
                record.update(status='ok_rhythm_interventions', outputs=outputs, intervention_kind='rhythm_only',
                              source_sha256={'carrier': carrier_row['sha256'], 'native_donor': row['sha256'],
                                             'hindi_donor': item['hindi_prosody_donor']['row']['sha256']})
            except ValueError:
                logging.exception('Explicit rhythm-control exclusion %s', item['id'])
                record.update(status='excluded_rhythm_intervention', error=traceback.format_exc())
            with (out / 'rows.jsonl').open('a') as f:
                f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
            counts[record['status']] += 1
            temp = out / 'status.partial'
            temp.write_text(json.dumps({'phase': 'building_word_rhythm_controls', 'counts': dict(counts),
                                       'updated_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}, indent=2) + '\n')
            temp.replace(out / 'status.json')
        report = {'status': 'complete_word_rhythm_controls', 'counts': dict(counts), 'actual_hindi_error_accuracy': None}
        for name in ('report.json', 'status.json'):
            (out / name).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps(report))
    except Exception:
        (out / 'status.json').write_text(json.dumps({'phase': 'failed_explicitly', 'error': traceback.format_exc()}, indent=2) + '\n')
        raise


if __name__ == '__main__':
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        logging.exception('Physical word-rhythm experiment failed explicitly')
        raise

"""Monotone duration intervention with fixed carrier spectra, pitch and pauses."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d


def duration_map(carrier_words, donor_words, seconds, *, minimum_word_seconds=.08):
    if minimum_word_seconds not in {.08, .03}:
        raise ValueError('Only the original80ms or explicitly revised30ms protocol is supported')
    if [w['word'] for w in carrier_words] != [w['word'] for w in donor_words] or len(carrier_words) < 3:
        raise ValueError('Identical canonical word sequence required for duration transfer')
    c = np.array([[w['start'], w['end']] for w in carrier_words], float)
    d = np.array([[w['start'], w['end']] for w in donor_words], float)
    for spans in (c, d):
        if (not np.isfinite(spans).all() or np.any(spans[:, 0] < 0) or np.any(spans[:, 1] <= spans[:, 0])
                or np.any(spans[1:, 0] < spans[:-1, 1] - 1e-8)):
            raise ValueError('Measured nonoverlapping positive word spans required')
    if not np.isfinite(seconds) or seconds < c[-1, 1] - 1e-7:
        raise ValueError('Aligned word extends beyond full carrier duration')
    original = c[:, 1] - c[:, 0]
    desired = (d[:, 1] - d[:, 0]) * original.sum() / (d[:, 1] - d[:, 0]).sum()
    ratio = desired / original
    if np.any((ratio < .4) | (ratio > 2.5)) or np.any(desired < minimum_word_seconds):
        raise ValueError('Local word stretch outside frozen.4..2.5 or word below explicit minimum')
    target = c.copy()
    for i in range(len(c)):
        target[i, 0] = c[0, 0] if i == 0 else target[i - 1, 1] + c[i, 0] - c[i - 1, 1]
        target[i, 1] = target[i, 0] + desired[i]
    if abs(target[-1, 1] - c[-1, 1]) > 1e-7:
        raise AssertionError('Relative word redistribution changed total utterance duration')
    source_knots, target_knots = [0.], [0.]
    for old, new in zip(c.reshape(-1), target.reshape(-1), strict=True):
        if abs(old - source_knots[-1]) < 1e-8:
            if abs(new - target_knots[-1]) > 1e-7:
                raise ValueError('Zero carrier gap acquired synthetic duration')
            continue
        source_knots.append(float(old))
        target_knots.append(float(new))
    if seconds > source_knots[-1] + 1e-7:
        source_knots.append(float(seconds))
        target_knots.append(float(seconds))
    if np.any(np.diff(source_knots) <= 0) or np.any(np.diff(target_knots) <= 0):
        raise ValueError('Duration intervention must preserve strictly ordered sound positions')
    return np.array(source_knots), np.array(target_knots), target, ratio


def retime_parameters(times, f0, spectrum, aperiodicity, source_knots, target_knots):
    times, f0, spectrum, aperiodicity = [np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in (times, f0, spectrum, aperiodicity)]
    if (times.ndim != 1 or f0.shape != times.shape or spectrum.ndim != 2 or spectrum.shape != aperiodicity.shape
            or len(spectrum) != len(times) or any(not np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (times, f0, spectrum, aperiodicity))
            or np.any(np.diff(times) <= 0) or np.any(f0 < 0)):
        raise ValueError('Finite matching measured WORLD parameters required')
    source_time = np.interp(times, target_knots, source_knots)
    # Nearest-frame F0 preserves the carrier voiced/unvoiced values rather than
    # inventing intermediate pitches at voicing transitions. Spectral envelopes
    # interpolate in time; no donor spectrum, aperiodicity or pitch is imported.
    nearest = np.clip(np.searchsorted(times, source_time), 1, len(times) - 1)
    nearest -= (np.abs(times[nearest - 1] - source_time) < np.abs(times[nearest] - source_time))
    pitch = f0[nearest].copy()
    spectral = interp1d(times, spectrum, axis=0, bounds_error=True)(source_time)
    noise = interp1d(times, aperiodicity, axis=0, bounds_error=True)(source_time)
    return np.ascontiguousarray(pitch), np.ascontiguousarray(spectral), np.ascontiguousarray(noise)

"""Aligned phonetic posteriors and normalized prosody, without hidden embeddings."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from hindi_detector.local_features import PROSODY_NAMES, relative_tracks, word_prosody
from hindi_detector.g2p_evidence import compile_word_hypotheses, word_path_evidence
from hindi_detector.schwa_probe import compare_site, site_paths


def normalized_words(text: str, romanizer) -> list[dict]:
    words = []
    for match in re.finditer(r'\S+', text):
        raw = match.group()
        lexical = ''.join(c for c in raw if unicodedata.category(c)[0] in {'L', 'M', 'N'})
        if not lexical:
            continue
        if any(unicodedata.category(c)[0] == 'N' for c in lexical):
            raise ValueError('Numeric token needs an explicit spoken expansion; never silently drop it')
        roman = romanizer.romanize_string(lexical, lcode='nep').lower().replace('’', "'")
        if re.search(r"[^a-z' ]", roman):
            raise ValueError(f'Romanization has unsupported symbols: {raw!r} -> {roman!r}')
        roman = roman.replace(' ', '')
        if not roman:
            raise ValueError(f'Word vanished during romanization: {raw!r}')
        words.append({'word': lexical, 'display': raw, 'roman': roman,
                      'text_start': match.start(), 'text_end': match.end()})
    if not words:
        raise ValueError('No alignable words')
    return words


class WordEvidenceEngine:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, *, g2p_word_bank: list[dict] | None = None,
                 device: str = 'cpu', pitch_method: str = 'harvest', hidden_layers: tuple[int, ...] = (),
                 temporal_bins: int = 0, schwa_candidates: list[dict] | None = None,
                 lexical_ipa: dict[str, str] | None = None,
                 retain_frame_evidence: bool = False):
        import torch
        import torchaudio
        import pyworld
        import uroman
        from transformers import AutoFeatureExtractor, AutoModelForCTC

        self.torch, self.world = torch, pyworld
        if device not in {'cpu', 'mps'} or device == 'mps' and not torch.backends.mps.is_available():
            raise ValueError('Requested word encoder device is unavailable/unsupported')
        if pitch_method not in {'harvest', 'dio'} or any(type(i) is not int or i < 1 for i in hidden_layers):
            raise ValueError('Need explicit supported pitch recipe and positive hidden-layer indices')
        self.device, self.pitch_method, self.hidden_layers = device, pitch_method, hidden_layers
        if temporal_bins not in {0, 20} or (schwa_candidates is None) != (lexical_ipa is None):
            raise ValueError('Need explicit supported temporal geometry and complete optional site inputs')
        self.temporal_bins = temporal_bins
        torch.set_num_threads(2)
        directory = root / 'models/mms_fa'
        inventory = json.loads((directory / 'inventory.json').read_text())
        path = directory / inventory['file']
        if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != inventory['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Alignment checkpoint identity changed')
        bundle = torchaudio.pipelines.MMS_FA
        if bundle._path != inventory['url'] or torchaudio.__version__ != inventory['torchaudio']:
            raise ValueError('Alignment bundle/runtime changed')
        self.alignment = bundle.get_model(dl_kwargs={'model_dir': str(directory), 'file_name': path.name, 'weights_only': True}).eval().to(device)
        self.tokenizer, self.aligner = bundle.get_tokenizer(), bundle.get_aligner()
        self.romanizer = uroman.Uroman()
        self.aligner_inventory = inventory
        probe = root / 'models/phoneme_probe'
        phone_inventory = json.loads((probe / 'inventory.json').read_text())
        for item in phone_inventory['files']:
            p = probe / item['path']
            if p.stat().st_size != item['bytes'] or hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != item['sha256']:
                raise ValueError('Phone checkpoint inventory mismatch')
        self.extractor = AutoFeatureExtractor.from_pretrained(probe, local_files_only=True)
        self.phone = AutoModelForCTC.from_pretrained(probe, local_files_only=True).eval().to(device)
        if any(i > self.phone.config.num_hidden_layers for i in hidden_layers):
            raise ValueError('Requested hidden layer exceeds actual phone encoder depth')
        self.vocab = json.loads((probe / 'vocab.json').read_text())
        self.tokens = {i: token for token, i in self.vocab.items()}
        self.special = {self.vocab[token] for token in ['<pad>', '<s>', '</s>', '<unk>']}
        self.phone_inventory = phone_inventory
        self.retain_frame_evidence = retain_frame_evidence
        self.g2p_hypotheses = compile_word_hypotheses(g2p_word_bank, self.vocab, self.special) if g2p_word_bank is not None else {}
        self.site_hypotheses = {}
        for candidate in schwa_candidates or []:
            try:
                record = {'candidate_id': candidate['candidate_id'], 'status': 'supported',
                          'paths': site_paths(candidate, lexical_ipa, self.vocab)}
            except ValueError as error:
                record = {'candidate_id': candidate['candidate_id'], 'status': 'unsupported', 'reason': str(error)}
            self.site_hypotheses.setdefault(candidate['word'], []).append(record)
        self.other_vowels = sorted({self.vocab[token] for token in ('a','aː','e','eː','i','iː','o','oː','u','uː','ɪ','ʊ','ɛ','ɔ','æ') if token in self.vocab})

    def analyze(self, samples: np.ndarray, text: str) -> tuple[dict, dict[str, np.ndarray]]:
        torch = self.torch
        samples = np.asarray(samples, dtype=np.float32)
        if samples.ndim != 1 or not np.isfinite(samples).all() or not 3200 <= len(samples) <= 30 * 16000 or np.max(np.abs(samples)) < 1e-5:
            raise ValueError('Need finite non-silent 16 kHz mono speech between .2 and 30 seconds')
        words = normalized_words(text, self.romanizer)
        with torch.inference_mode():
            emission, _ = self.alignment(torch.from_numpy(samples)[None].to(self.device))
            log_alignment = emission[0].log_softmax(-1).cpu()
            if not torch.isfinite(log_alignment).all():
                raise ValueError('Nonfinite alignment model output')
            aligned = self.aligner(log_alignment, self.tokenizer([w['roman'] for w in words]))
            encoded = self.phone(**{k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in self.extractor(samples, sampling_rate=16000, return_tensors='pt').items()},
                                 output_hidden_states=bool(self.hidden_layers))
            phone_logits = encoded.logits[0]
            if not torch.isfinite(phone_logits).all():
                raise ValueError('Nonfinite phone model output')
        if len(aligned) != len(words) or any(not spans for spans in aligned):
            raise ValueError('Alignment did not retain every expected word')
        duration = len(samples) / 16000
        frame_seconds = duration / len(log_alignment)
        for word, spans in zip(words, aligned, strict=True):
            start, end = spans[0].start * frame_seconds, spans[-1].end * frame_seconds
            if not 0 <= start < end <= duration + 1e-6:
                raise ValueError('Impossible aligned word times')
            lengths = np.array([s.end - s.start for s in spans])
            score = float(np.average([s.score for s in spans], weights=lengths))
            word.update(start=float(start), end=float(end), alignment_score=score)
        # Fixed shared analysis rate and explicit broad adult-speech pitch range.
        pitch_function = self.world.harvest if self.pitch_method == 'harvest' else self.world.dio
        f0, times = pitch_function(samples.astype(np.float64), 16000, f0_floor=50., f0_ceil=650., frame_period=5.)
        f0 = self.world.stonemask(samples.astype(np.float64), f0, times, 16000)
        smooth_energy = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.convolve(samples.astype(float) ** 2, np.ones(320) / 320, mode='same'), 0))
        rms = np.interp(times, np.arange(len(samples)) / 16000, smooth_energy)
        prosody = word_prosody(times, f0, rms, words)
        relative_pitch, relative_energy = relative_tracks(f0, rms)
        probabilities = torch.softmax(phone_logits, -1).cpu().numpy()
        log_probabilities = torch.log_softmax(phone_logits, -1).cpu().numpy() if self.g2p_hypotheses or self.site_hypotheses or self.retain_frame_evidence else None
        hidden = {i: encoded.hidden_states[i][0].cpu().numpy() for i in self.hidden_layers}
        if any(v.ndim != 2 or len(v) != len(probabilities) or not np.isfinite(v).all() for v in hidden.values()):
            raise ValueError('Hidden encoder geometry/values disagree with actual phone frames')
        hidden_words = {i: [] for i in hidden}
        phone_vectors = []; temporal_vectors = []
        for word, pvector in zip(words, prosody, strict=True):
            start = max(0, int(np.floor(word['start'] / duration * len(probabilities))))
            end = min(len(probabilities), max(start + 1, int(np.ceil(word['end'] / duration * len(probabilities)))))
            values = probabilities[start:end].copy()
            for layer, states in hidden.items():
                part = states[start:end]
                hidden_words[layer].append(np.r_[part.mean(0), part.std(0)])
            values[:, sorted(self.special)] = 0
            mass = values.sum(axis=1)
            if self.temporal_bins:
                central = probabilities[start:end][:, [self.vocab[t] for t in ('ʌ','ə','ɐ')]]
                channels = np.column_stack([central, central / np.maximum(mass[:,None],1e-8), mass,
                                           probabilities[start:end][:, self.other_vowels].sum(axis=1)])
                positions = np.linspace(0,len(channels)-1,self.temporal_bins)
                temporal_vectors.append(np.stack([np.interp(positions,np.arange(len(channels)),channels[:,i]) for i in range(channels.shape[1])],axis=1))
                word['temporal_phone_frames'] = len(channels)
            available = float(mass.sum()) > 1e-5
            if available:
                mean = values.sum(axis=0) / mass.sum()
                conditional = values / np.maximum(mass[:, None], 1e-20)
                spread = np.sqrt(((conditional - mean) ** 2 * mass[:, None]).sum(0) / mass.sum())
            else:
                mean, spread = np.zeros(len(self.vocab)), np.zeros(len(self.vocab))
            path = probabilities[start:end].argmax(axis=1)
            collapsed = [int(token) for i, token in enumerate(path) if (i == 0 or token != path[i - 1]) and token not in self.special]
            word.update(phone_evidence_available=available, phone_probe_sequence=' '.join(self.tokens[t] for t in collapsed),
                        central_vowel_posteriors={token: float(mean[self.vocab[token]]) for token in ['ə', 'ɐ', 'ʌ']},
                        prosody={name: float(value) for name, value in zip(PROSODY_NAMES, pvector, strict=True)})
            if word['word'] in self.g2p_hypotheses:
                left = max(0, int(np.floor(max(0., word['start'] - .03) / duration * len(probabilities))))
                right = min(len(probabilities), int(np.ceil(min(duration, word['end'] + .03) / duration * len(probabilities))))
                word['g2p_path_evidence'] = word_path_evidence(log_probabilities[left:right], self.g2p_hypotheses[word['word']])
                word['g2p_path_evidence']['boundary_context_seconds'] = .03
            if word['word'] in self.site_hypotheses:
                measured = []
                for candidate in self.site_hypotheses[word['word']]:
                    if candidate['status'] != 'supported':
                        measured.append({k:v for k,v in candidate.items() if k!='paths'}); continue
                    sites = []
                    for path in candidate['paths']:
                        windows = []
                        for padding in (0., .03, .06):
                            left=max(0,int(np.floor(max(0.,word['start']-padding)/duration*len(probabilities))))
                            right=min(len(probabilities),int(np.ceil(min(duration,word['end']+padding)/duration*len(probabilities))))
                            try:
                                evidence=compare_site(log_probabilities[left:right],path)
                                windows.append({'padding_seconds':padding,'frames':right-left,'status':'supported',
                                    'alternative_minus_lexicon_per_frame':evidence['marginal_alternative_minus_lexicon']/(right-left)})
                            except ValueError as error:
                                windows.append({'padding_seconds':padding,'status':'impossible','reason':str(error)})
                        sites.append({'gap_index':path['gap_index'],'lexicon_schwa_count':path['lexicon_schwa_count'],
                            'alternative_schwa_count':path['alternative_schwa_count'],
                            'skeleton_length':sum(p!='ax' for p in path['lexicon_project_phones']), 'windows':windows})
                    measured.append({'candidate_id':candidate['candidate_id'],'status':'site_paths_measured_not_error_labels','sites':sites})
                word['schwa_site_evidence']=measured
            phone_vectors.append(np.r_[mean, spread])
        phonetics = np.asarray(phone_vectors, dtype=np.float32)
        if not np.isfinite(phonetics).all():
            raise ValueError('Nonfinite phone features')
        result = {'status': 'aligned_word_evidence_not_validated_hindi_labels', 'text': text,
                  'seconds': duration, 'words': words,
                  'tracks': {'times': times.tolist(),
                             'pitch_relative_st': [float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else None for v in relative_pitch],
                             'energy_relative_db': relative_energy.tolist()},
                  'normalization': {'absolute_pitch_not_a_feature': True, 'absolute_loudness_not_a_feature': True,
                                    'global_tempo_not_a_relative_word_feature': True,
                                    'hidden_speech_embeddings_not_used': not bool(self.hidden_layers)},
                  'encoder_device': self.device, 'pitch_method': self.pitch_method, 'hidden_layers': list(self.hidden_layers),
                  'temporal_bins': self.temporal_bins,
                  'warnings': ['Alignment scores are not calibrated pronunciation correctness.',
                               'Phone probe is not validated as a Nepali schwa recognizer.',
                               'Central-vowel posterior differences are evidence to inspect, not automatic Hindi word labels.',
                               'Pitch-register normalization does not prove invariance to complete voice conversion.']}
        if self.retain_frame_evidence:
            result['phone_frame_seconds'] = duration / len(probabilities)
        return result, {'phonetics': phonetics, 'prosody': prosody,
                        'times': times.astype(np.float32), 'f0_hz_for_qa_only': f0.astype(np.float32),
                        **({'temporal_phone':np.asarray(temporal_vectors,dtype=np.float32)} if self.temporal_bins else {}),
                        **({'phone_log_probs':log_probabilities.astype(np.float32)} if self.retain_frame_evidence else {}),
                        **{f'hidden_word_{layer}': np.stack(values).astype(np.float16) for layer, values in hidden_words.items()}}
